title: The Creative Act
summary: A framed composition that paints itself only while it is in your sight, and only as much of it as you can see.
mechanism: IntersectionObserver's intersectionRatio draws a per-visit generative composition in exact proportion to how much of the frame is in the spectator's view; scroll away and it un-paints — no storage, no network.
references: Umberto Eco, The Open Work / Opera aperta (1962)
